column3: Section  20A  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
repealed and the following section is substituted therefor: -
20A.  (1)  Every  application  for  an  order
under  subsection  (5)  or  (6)  of  section  2A,
subsection (5) of section 2B or subsection (4)
or (5) of section 4A shall be supported by an
affidavit  verifying  the  matters  set  out  in  the
application.
(2) Upon receipt of the application, where
the Magistrate is satisfied that an act has been
committed in contravention of the provisions
of subsection (5) or (6) of section 2A, subsection
(5)  of  section  2B  or  subsection  (4)  or  (5)  of
section  4 A,  may  make  an  interim  order
restraining such person, his agents and servants
from carrying on such unlawful activity until
such  interim  order  is  made  permanent  under
the provisions of subsection (4) or (7) or is set
aside under the provisions of subsection (7).
(3) Summons shall be issued on the person

against  whom 
the 
interim  order  under
subsection (2) is made or where an interim order
has not been made by the Magistrate’s Court
